MGM+ will premiere the four-part documentary series *New Wave* on November 23, exploring a movement that had a profound influence on popular music from the late 1970s through the end of the 1980s. New wave did not emerge as a single musical formula, nor can it be reduced to one city or band. Its distinctive character came from combining punk, pop structures, sonic experimentation and electronic technologies. This produced songs that retained the rebellious energy of the alternative scene while incorporating melodies and rhythms accessible to a wider audience. Rather than rejecting pop conventions, performers used them to create unusual arrangements, different vocal approaches and a visual identity that departed from the rock aesthetics of the time.

The series also examines this period through the changing relationship between musicians and audiences.
